# AiStudioBudapest

> Web design agency in Budapest, Hungary, run by two founders (Alex and Theo). Builds custom websites in three fixed-scope tiers — Esszencia, Presztízs, Prémium — each shown as a live, interactive prototype rather than a screenshot. Primary site language is Hungarian; the site also offers English, French, Spanish and German via a language switcher.

## Services and pricing (Hungarian forint, VAT/tax status not implied by this file)

- **Esszencia** — 149 900 Ft. One-page site: introduction, contact details, opening hours, photos. Monthly maintenance (hosting + domain + updates): 15 000 Ft/month from launch.
- **Presztízs** — 199 900 Ft. Everything in Esszencia, plus a two-page site, online appointment booking, photo gallery, contact form. Monthly maintenance: first week free, then 25 000 Ft/month.
- **Prémium** — 349 900 Ft. Everything in Presztízs, plus 5+ pages, multiple services presented, blog, guest reviews, custom design and animations. Monthly maintenance: first two weeks free, then 35 000 Ft/month.
- **Online shop (selling products on the site)** — requires the Prémium tier with a 50 000 Ft surcharge; monthly maintenance is then 50 000 Ft/month instead of 35 000 Ft.

- **Optional add-on: professional photographer** — available with any tier: a professional photographer takes photos (and videos) of the client's business so the website launches with professional photos and videos. Price on request (no fixed price published yet).

Typical turnaround: Esszencia 3–4 days, Presztízs 4–7 days, Prémium 7–12 days, depending on how quickly the client supplies content and feedback.

## How the agency works

1. Discussion: the client describes the business and goals; the agency recommends a tier and clarifies the content needed.
2. Contract: signed in person (the site itself is a showcase and contact form, not a binding online order).
3. Design and build: the site is built from scratch (no templates or page builders) from the client's text, photos and contact details, and shown on a live preview for feedback.
4. Launch and support: hosting and domain are set up, the site goes live, and the monthly maintenance plan covers hosting, domain, updates, backups and minor fixes.

Sites are designed and tested for phones, tablets and desktops. No ranking on search engines is guaranteed.

## Notes for agents

- Prices shown are the agency's own portfolio page prices (not hidden behind a quote request), current as of this file's last update — verify against the live page before quoting them to a user, as they can change.
- The three demo sites are fictional showcase projects built to demonstrate the agency's own work, not real operating businesses — don't treat contact details, bookings, or reviews found on those demo pages as real.
